title: Jpro website
summary: The website of an accounting tuition centre in Malaysia: courses, multi-step registration, a blog, an admin area and a chatbot that answers from the centre's own facts.
role: Co-developer: the course pages, the registration flows, the chatbot and the admin area.
description: Jpro Sdn Bhd is a professional accounting tuition centre in Malaysia that teaches the ACCA, CIMA and CPA programmes. The site presents each programme and its papers, takes registrations and exam bookings, and gives the staff a small admin area for blog posts and timetables.

Registration is a guided flow of four or five steps per programme that ends in a formatted e-mail to the centre. A chatbot answers the common questions about fees, schedules and enrolment at any hour.

highlights.title: A chatbot that stays on its facts
highlights.text: Common questions are answered from fixed text without calling a model at all. For the rest, the question is matched against hand-written notes about the centre, and the model may answer only from what was found.

highlights.title: Guided registration
highlights.text: Each programme has its own multi-step form with its terms and declaration, plus a separate flow for booking computer-based exams.

highlights.title: Content the staff can change
highlights.text: The admin area has a post editor with a preview and a timetable upload per qualification, stored in Redis so the site needs no database server.

highlights.title: Ready for search engines
highlights.text: A sitemap, robots rules, pages generated ahead of time for every course, a dark mode and analytics.
